description: Opening-balance, year-end-close and Kestrel special-period journals are written without the line attributes the approved mapping contract requires, so a conditional split cannot be derived from the posting. The engine resolves them to the account's declared default branch, which is the only defensible answer available.
rationale: Accepted because the pipeline is behaving correctly and Phase 3 may not patch the frozen source layer. The population is frozen at the count observed on the approved baseline: one MORE line than this is a new break, not this one, and the control fails outright.

description: The same defect measured on the population it belongs to: postings to a conditional account that carry none of the attributes its rules read and therefore resolve to the wrong branch.
Seven Kestrel postings to 00017000 Aktive Rechnungsabgrenzung carry no accrual_type, so USD 2.33m sits in prepayments instead of contract assets at FY2025 and correspondingly in FY2023 and FY2024.
rationale: Accepted, but the amount is material to the caption (26%) and is escalated as a blocker for Phase 4. Frozen at six caption-years -- contract assets and prepayments in each of FY2023, FY2024 and FY2025; a seventh is a new break.

description: Contract assets are driven to a credit balance at the Kestrel entities by the same unclassified accrued-income postings.
rationale: See SX-003. Frozen at seven; any other account class appearing with an inverted sign fails the control outright.

description: A posting declares one classification in its line attributes and sits in a cost centre carrying another. The mapping contract names the declared attribute as authoritative, so the mapping is right; the cost-centre dimension does not corroborate it.
rationale: Accepted because no reported figure is affected. THE POPULATION IS THE CONTROL: a posting whose declared classification stops agreeing with its cost centre after this baseline shows up as one more line, and the control fails outright rather than hiding inside the known population.

description: The cash settlement leg of an intercompany balance, the group treasury current account and the intercompany loan accounts carry no counterparty, so an intercompany BALANCE cannot be attributed to an entity pair.
rationale: Accepted for Phase 3 only. It is a blocker for Phase 4's intercompany balance sheet elimination: only 37% of the intercompany receivable and payable position at FY2025 is attributable to a pair.

description: Kestrel special period 15 reallocates between corporate income tax and trade tax, moving an amount from the income-taxes-payable caption into accrued liabilities.
rationale: Accepted: USD 0.126m at FY2025. P2-FMT-09 tested that a special period does not move the year's result; it does not test the balance sheet captions.
